description: Ministry of Defence - Subsequent amendments to the Consolidated List under Regulation 4(2)(b) of the United Nations Regulations No. 2 of 2012
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters by publishing amendments to the United Nations Regulations No. 2 of 2012. It contains updates to the Consolidated List of designated persons under anti-terrorism regulations, which falls under legal frameworks, regulatory compliance requirements, and statutory instruments. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
